METHOD CONVERSION (PIPELINE.md stage 3b): 20 of the 28 members are real dMgJump3DMario_c:: methods -- the three virtuals, D1 and C1 that already carried mangled names, plus fifteen converted in this commit. It cost no bytes: 28/28 MATCH before and after the conversion, objisolate clean, emission order still ROM-ascending. The other eight keep their `func_ov006_*` names because twelve direct `bl` sites in seven `.c` shards below the run name them by their C spelling; two independent scans (relocs.txt filtered on `module:overlay(6)`, and a raw ARM BL decode of the overlay image) agreed on the same 12 sites and the same 8 targets. They convert when those shards are promoted, not before.

THE FIFTEEN NEW MEMBER NAMES ARE COINED. The cartridge proves each member's address, size, that its first argument is the object, and -- for the nine reached through a pointer-to-member -- which 8-byte record in the unowned .data at 0x0213b020..0x0213b098 installs it and which member writes that record. It proves no spelling. The derivation is written out in include/dMgJump3DMario_c.h and the fifteen rows are logged in symbols/actor_renames.tsv. The three virtual names stay address-derived (Unk_020c76d8 / Unk_020c76d0 / Unk_020c762c); nothing in the ROM carries their 2004 spelling.

SYMBOLS.TXT MOVED IN THIS COMMIT -- 15 rows in config/arm9/overlays/ov006/symbols.txt. That is not the usual text-only promotion, which touches no symbols.txt at all. Fifteen 8-byte pointer-to-member records sit in ov006's UNOWNED .data at 0x0213b020..0x0213b098 and dsd resolves each record's code word by the NAME symbols.txt gives at the target address, so a converted member whose row still said `func_ov006_*` would link its .data word as 0x00000000 with a green compile. No byte gate at verify or linkcheck-of-the-TU catches it.

include/dMgJump3DMario_c.h gained fifteen non-virtual member declarations and no field or virtual.
